description: Sparkline KPI Card Convergent Business Technologies · Free · All features included Sparkline KPI Card consolidates KPI values and trend analysis into one compact card — current value, prior-period comparison, target, variance, trend indicators, and an interactive sparkline, without relying on multiple visuals. The visual responds automatically to filters, slicers, and cross-filtering, suited for executive dashboards, scorecards, financial reporting, and operational performance monitoring. Key Capabilities KPI Summary — Displays name, current, previous, target, variance, and trend indicator in one visual. Sparkline Trend — Visualizes KPI performance over time using configurable Line or Area sparklines. Previous Period Comparison — Compares the selected period against its equivalent prior period. Dynamic Aggregation — Supports Sum, Average, Min, Max, Count, Distinct Count, Median, Variance, and Standard Deviation. Variance Analysis — Calculates percentage differences with configurable formatting and colors. Interactive Tooltips — Shows Month, Year, and KPI value on hover. Flexible Formatting — Customizes fonts, colors, backgrounds, borders, and spacing. Native Integration — Supports filters, slicers, cross-filtering, cross-highlighting, and responsive layouts.
